newsitem.title: USA: Colonial BancGroup to buy bank for $17mln.
newsitem.headline: Colonial BancGroup to buy bank for $17mln.

text.p: Colonial BancGroup Inc and First Commerce Banks of Florida Inc said Friday they have signed a letter of intent to merge First Commerce Banks into Colonial in a transaction valued at $17.3 million.

Each share of First Commerce stock will be exchanged for 0.4326 shares of Colonial common stock if the market value of Colonial stock at closing is between $19.35 and $23.65 per share. If the market value of Colonial stock falls outside that range the number of Colonial shares issued will be adjusted. Colonial also said it will assume First Commerce options and warrants at the same ratio.
First Commerce, based in Winter Haven, Florida, had assets of $106 million at December 31. Colonial BancGroup, is based in Montgomery, Ala. and has assets of $6 billion.
Completion of the transaction is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval.
